metaDescription: Terms of sale for orders placed with Mudiyanse Auto Solutions.
heading: Terms of Sale

prices.heading: Prices
prices.body: All prices are shown in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR) and may change without notice.

stock.heading: Stock Availability
stock.body: Items are subject to availability. Stock levels shown on the site are live, but an item can occasionally sell out between browsing and checkout.

confirmation.heading: Order Confirmation
confirmation.body: All orders are Cash on Delivery and may be confirmed by phone or WhatsApp before dispatch.

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.body: See our <1>Delivery Information</1> page for courier options, areas and fees.

returns.heading: Returns
returns.body: See our <1>Returns & Refunds</1> policy for how we handle returns, exchanges and refunds.

law.heading: Governing Law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Sri Lanka.
